content: Task ledger update: Hermes dashboard ARDA HUD workstation shell implemented. Implemented read-only Hermes Dashboard workstation shell in ARDA HUD: typed ModuleId, module export, desk button, floating workstation routing, in-scene/native manifest, and dashboard UI using package enablement/runtime activation data. Verified npm run build, npm test, and soterion unicode guard pass. Native cargo check is blocked by missing host gdk-3.0.pc/gtk3-devel, not by Rust code changes.
